excluded.note_79110: test_kbli_eye.test_travel_agency_terbatas_carries_full_cap asserts '79110 is TERBATAS but the adjudicated cap is 100% - never 0'. That determination lives in a TEST, not in pma_official_basis, so this applier's refuse-on-prior-basis rule could not see it. Two in-repo determinations disagree; resolving it needs #3317's history read, not a silent overwrite.
